acceptance: DATE_TRUNC with DAY (and any other unit TRUNC doesn't support) writes DATE_TRUNC on Spark/Databricks; pyspark test compares grouped keys against DuckDB.
Corpus diff lists every changed query; ENGINE-GAPS entry removed.
Published bundles affected are listed; sql-execution-gate and the adoption checks pass.
description:
Found while fixing Databricks ClickBench Q29/Q43 (fork #69). Spark's TRUNC accepts only year, quarter, month and week units and returns NULL for others; #69 fixed HOUR through MICROSECOND but left DAY writing TRUNC(x,'DAY'), recorded in the fork's downstream/ENGINE-GAPS.md. Any benchmark query truncating to day on Spark or Databricks returns NULL groups.
GUARDRAILS: fix in the fork's spark2 generator with a pyspark engine test (in-process job); corpus diff of every changed Spark/Databricks query; affected published bundles listed and flagged only if recorded rows were wrong; wheel cut under the batch mutex; no cloud spend.
